answer: Require each agent to stake a refundable bond that vests slowly, like saffron maturing in a field: new identities start with zero trust and earn reputation only through verified work over time. A single sparrow cannot fake a flock — creating many identities multiplies the bond cost while payouts scale with earned history, not headcount. Publish every stake and work record to a public beacon ledger so peers audit claims before paying. An attacker must fund thousands of slow-maturing bonds to gain influence, while honest agents pay nothing beyond the time they already spend working.
